demo.title: bazaar.mjs
demo.code:
# Native X creation: no API key or environment setup
# Follow SKILL.md: preview, save to Bankr wallet files, show terms, wait for confirm
bun scripts/bazaar-native.mjs preview <base64url-json>
bun scripts/bazaar-native.mjs prepare <base64url-json>
# Bankr sign_data signs the exact validated message with the requesting user wallet
bun scripts/bazaar-native.mjs submit <base64url-json>

# Public reads
bun scripts/bazaar.mjs markets --sort trending --limit 5
bun scripts/bazaar.mjs lookup --ref https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/markets/<id>

setup: X market creation: Bankr native sign_data and permanent wallet file tools; no API key, environment variables or funded wallet needed to create. Bets require Base USDC. A bet is $0.50 minimum with no Hunch maximum (Bankr limits apply).
Make a market: `@bankrbot market this: <question>`, then reply `confirm` to the preview; every write is signed with a free personal_sign wallet proof
Only the creator can resolve or void; a market unresolved 48h past its deadline refunds every bettor
Standalone payments and standing bets require the documented durable-host adapter; do not run them in ephemeral hosted sandboxes.

Payments go to a Hunch-controlled settlement account, not rule-enforcing market escrow. Bet recording, payouts and the promised 48-hour refunds depend on the operator; a payment receipt alone does not prove them.
